hypotheses.evidence_against: Tiny sampled fraction; CIGA (I40)=0.5143 shows N40 not required at moderate fitness.
hypotheses.evidence_for: All top variants carry N40; N40->I/M/P on CNGA reduced fitness to 0.5143/0.1851/0.0441.
hypotheses.prediction: Future variants above ~1.0 carry N40; N40->D/A/S on INGA scores below INGA.
hypotheses.statement: Position-40 asparagine is a strong enabler, possibly near-necessary, for high fitness in the explored region.

hypotheses.evidence_against: Thin sample (5/20 residues); C outperforming Q argues axis not purely steric.
hypotheses.evidence_for: Five measured residues rank by bulk/hydrophobicity.
hypotheses.prediction: Untested large/aliphatic L, M, F, V, Y at position 39 on NGA score >= WNGA.
hypotheses.statement: Position-39 fitness on NGA backbone follows large-aliphatic preference (I >> W > C > Q > D).

hypotheses.evidence_against: Single backbone pair observed; backbone-specific epistasis possible.
hypotheses.evidence_for: S41 improved CNGA (CNSA 0.9936); A41 is best on K39 backbones.
hypotheses.statement: G41->S benefit transfers to other N40 backbones, including INGA.

hypotheses.evidence_against: CV Spearman on nearly-flat sample is weak basis for top-of-distribution accuracy.
hypotheses.evidence_for: Exploitation backbone consensus found 2 improvements; DNGA=0.0118 shows misranking within a residue series.
hypotheses.prediction: Round-3 model picks cluster on N40/G41/A54 tails; >=2 of 4 exceed 0.6.
hypotheses.statement: ExtraTrees captures backbone-level structure (N40/G41/A54) but is not calibrated at residue level.

hypotheses.evidence_against: K39 never tested on G41 backbone.
hypotheses.evidence_for: All nine K39 variants <= 0.3322 across eight position-41 residues.
hypotheses.prediction: Any K39 variant on NGA backbone scores below 0.5.
hypotheses.statement: K39 is strongly deleterious; the uncertainty-selected K-region is a low-fitness plateau.

hypotheses.evidence_against: Only one position-54 comparison; V54 untested on high-fitness backbones.
hypotheses.evidence_for: A54->I reduced fitness 0.5971->0.2835; all exploitation picks carried A54.
hypotheses.falsifier: A position-54 substitution on INGA (e.g., INGV) exceeding 2.8315.
hypotheses.prediction: Position-54 series on INGA (V,S,G,T,N) peaks at A or S, none exceeding INGA.
hypotheses.statement: Position 54 favors small residues in this region (A > I on CNGA); INGA A54 near optimum.

hypotheses.evidence_for: Round-1 flatness with one outlier; 4.7x jump at Hamming distance 1 from CNGA.
hypotheses.prediction: Measured fitness decays with Hamming distance from INGA; random distance>=2 probes mostly < 0.3.
hypotheses.statement: Landscape is sparse and rugged; best found one mutation from round-1 best.

observations: R1: Round-1 random init (24 assays) nearly flat, 22/24 <= 0.0148, ~7 zeros, single outlier CNGA=0.5971.
R2: EXPLOIT_MODEL (4 assays) delivered WNGA=0.9770 and new best INGA=2.8315 (4.7x CNGA).
R3: LOCAL_MUTATE around CNGA gave CNSA=0.9936 (G41->S, +0.40 over parent); CIGA 0.5143, CNGI 0.2835, CMGA 0.1851, CPGA 0.0441, CNQA 0.0152 all lower.
R4: EXPLORE_UNCERTAIN (8 assays, K39-x41-A54 series) gave 0 improvements; best KNAA=0.3322, other 7 <= 0.0449.
R5: EXPLORE_DIVERSE (6 assays) gave 0 improvements, all <= 0.0072; GWHC rejected UNAVAILABLE.
R6: All top-4 variants carry N40 (INGA 2.8315, CNSA 0.9936, WNGA 0.9770, CNGA 0.5971).
R7: Position-39 fitness on NGA backbone: I(2.8315) > W(0.9770) > C(0.5971) > Q(0.3056) > D(0.0118).
R8: Position 41 prefers small residues: A41 best on K39 backbones; G41->S improved CNGA; G41->Q crashed to 0.0152.
R9: Surrogate n=48 ExtraTrees: CV RMSE 0.434, Spearman 0.533 (moderate rank accuracy, poor absolute calibration).
recommended_tests: Q1 (~9): untested position-39 residues on NGA (L,M,F,V,Y,S,T,A) plus INSA.
Q2 (6-8): Hamming-1 neighbors of INGA via re-parented LOCAL_MUTATE (LNGA/MNGA/FNGA; INSA/INAA; INGV/INGS).
Q3 (4): position-54 series on INGA (INGV, INGS, INGT, INGN).
Q4 (3): N40 perturbations on I39 backbone (IDGA, IAGA, ISGA).
Q5 (2-4): informed diversity probes at 39 on D40 backbones (LDGV/WDGV-style).
Q6: Defer formal INGA replicate to round 4.
strategy_implications: S-1: Re-parent LOCAL_MUTATE onto INGA in round 3.
S-2: Convert most EXPLORE_UNCERTAIN budget into targeted one-position sweeps on the INGA backbone.
S-3: Keep EXPLORE_DIVERSE small (~4) and informed (large-aliphatic at 39 on non-N40 tails).
S-4: Map the INGA peak via tight neighbors this round; defer formal replicate to round 4.
S-5: Use surrogate strictly as ranker within model-chosen clusters, not absolute-fitness gatekeeper.
uncertainties: U-1: INGA=2.8315 is a single unreplicated measurement, could be an assay outlier.
U-2: Sampling confounded: all exploitation picks carried N40/G41/A54.
U-3: Only 5/20 residues tested at position 39 on NGA backbone.
U-4: Surrogate CV metrics computed on almost-flat sample.
U-5: GWHC UNAVAILABLE rejection flags unknown assay-service constraint.
U-6: Epistasis between position 41 and backbone untested.
U-7: WT-background numbering assumption not independently verified.
